`domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`, 2026-09-17T11:58Z.

This seat filed this card at 2026-09-17T11:38Z on the premise that `packages/plugin-tree` was correctly fenced out of objectui#9550's delivery. **That premise was wrong, and it was this seat's error.** The triage grading on objectui#9550 ([`5710385032`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9550#issuecomment-5710385032)) had already ordered this exact repair in its 修法边界 section — 「#8655 那份手抄件在补导出之后应当删掉并改为 import,⛔ 否则第二权威照旧存在,而这张卡看起来已经修好了」 — and this seat's dispatch order failed to carry that line and then fenced the file out explicitly.

The at-tier contract review on PR #9685 caught it and returned **FAIL** ([`5713907760`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/9685#issuecomment-5713907760)). ⇒ the fence is amended and the repair is now a **blocking patch-round item inside PR #9685**, where the ruling put it in the first place.

⇒ **Expected disposition:** closed as `duplicate` of objectui#9550 once PR #9685's patch round lands. ⛔ It is deliberately left open until then rather than closed early, so that if the patch round somehow does not carry the repair, the finding still has a carrier and does not evaporate.

⛔ **Do not dispatch this card.** ⛔ Do not grade it as fresh work — the body's finding is sound and independently re-verified, but its owner is now PR #9685.
